boundary.source: existing P5 result JSON summaries only
boundary.claim_boundary: P5-L updates the B2c/R0c mechanism interpretation after R0c K1 scroll batching and a B2c rerun. It does not prove impossible-zone completion, runtime superiority, or P4 eligibility.

updated_primary_claim: R0c K1 preserves the send-path-specific advantage over B2c: 15.8ms vs 20.4ms.
R0c K1 removes the prior scroll-proxy disadvantage and reaches B2c-level scroll parity: 12.2ms vs 11.7ms.
R0c K1 still does not dominate B2c overall because initial render and typing proxy remain worse.
Current evidence supports continued workload-axis investigation, not P4 authorization.
mechanism: Compact active-context indexing removed the shared send-path full-string scan bottleneck.
R0c's send-path advantage after shared optimization remains modest and send-specific.
K1 scroll batching replaced two serial Worker projection roundtrips with one batched old-history plus tail projection request.
After K1, scroll is approximately at B2c parity.
R0c still has startup/accounting overhead and small absolute typing Worker-dispatch overhead.

overhead_classification.interpretation: R0c K1 is modestly faster on the send-click proxy after shared compact-index optimization.
overhead_classification.risk: send-path-specific only; does not imply all-interaction dominance

overhead_classification.interpretation: K1 batching removes the prior R0c scroll-proxy disadvantage; the remaining 0.5ms delta is parity-level in this manual proxy setup.
overhead_classification.risk: scroll proxy is not browser frame-stability evidence

overhead_classification.interpretation: R0c K1 remains worse on typing proxy, but the absolute value is small and the metric is single-shot.
R0c K1 remains substantially slower on initial render, likely reflecting Worker startup, runtime initialization, and initial projection accounting.
overhead_classification.risk: not cleanly comparable to B2c initial render and not proven amortizable

overhead_classification.interpretation: R0c K1 has one internal 50ms-like proxy count while B2c has zero.
overhead_classification.risk: not browser Long Task API evidence
